title: Explore: the regions of the base sites and the roads to them (south, east, north), then every never-read system out to 14 jumps, nearest first
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-16 23:21 UTC for the explorers (rule F26; orders.log ENT-019: P4 and block ORACLE). The roads from scripts/map.py route nexus_prime <site>: to Aldebaran (9 jumps) by gsc_0050, brachium, gsc_0049, acrab, duskfield, giausar; to Yildun (11) by brachium, nightveil, marfik, regor, groombridge_34, chalawan, rasalhague; to Hawthorne (13) and Alchiba (14) past giausar by gsc_0028, gsc_0006, gsc_0042, avior. The systems already on census-frontier or census-worked stay there; this list holds the 14 never read on the roads, nearest site first, then 14 lawless systems one lane off a road (game/map/galaxy.tsv), none an empire system and none a stronghold. A never-read system is taken in list order; once read, every 480 minutes. Each system is read first by one ship with an empty hold (rules F3, F13); the census kind has flown 165 frontier runs without a loss (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Chalawan holds a HEXC outpost and GSC-0040 an ENDL outpost, both without a market (data/station/stations.json). What each read finds goes into the system file in game/planets/ the same turn. Widened by Oracle at 2026-11-17 03:24 UTC (orders.log ENT-027, P4 a: the south and the east first, they are nearer): the 18 never-read systems within two lanes of Biham, Felis, Diadem and Intercrus (game/map/galaxy.tsv; the roads to them, by scripts/map.py route, are all on census-worked or census-frontier and read): south biham, sualocin, jasmine, gsc_0035, elnath, coppervale, gsc_0024, mirach, alderamin, azha; east diadem, kitalpha, lanternwick, kepler_442, lacaille_8760, nembus, celaeno, grumium (Solarian space). Gliese 581 stays off (a pirate stronghold). The public battle record names pirate fights at Biham (7), Sualocin (5, three players lost) and Kitalpha (3) (data/observations, kind pirate, 2026-11-17 00:22 UTC): a census reads and leaves. 2026-11-17 07:21 UTC, Oracle: 97 never-read systems appended (Procyon Colonial Station first, for Trade's requests.log ENT-194; then every unread system of 8 to 14 jumps from home, nearest first, pirate strongholds Gliese 581 and Algol left out): the 46 systems of the three regions had all been read by 03:52 UTC and the explorers had fallen back to gathering (24 of 30 scouts gathering at 07:17 UTC). Exploration XP rises only on a first visit (catalog, table skills), so never-read systems are the explorers' class work (orders ENT-029, task 1).
